verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM presents itself as an AI assistant and agent ("a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device"), so it sits in the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The only MCP evidence is a docs page titled "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM" and an automated probe pointing to that same page. Neither describes a server mode (no serve command or hosted MCP endpoint), so the server axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
